detaileddescription.para: The AIROC Mesh Power Level Client module of the Mesh Models library provides a way for an application to control power level of the Power Level Servers in the mesh network optionally receive status information.
To include Power Level Client functionality, the device description shall contain WICED_BT_MESH_MODEL_POWER_LEVEL_CLIENT.
